---
title: "Plan: make pairloom public, then package it for the sibio conda channel"
author: "Yun Jiang"
date: 2026-10-27
---

# Objective

Follow the seqconsistency playbook (transcript of 2026-10-26): scrub
host-specific references, flip `jiangyun-fun/pairloom` to public, enable
the protections that unlock at public, release v0.1.0 with an sdist that
carries the Rust core, write a rattler-build recipe in the conda-recipes
repo, build it, and publish the package to the internal
`s3://conda/sibio` channel.

# Steps (as executed)

## A. Public-readiness scrub — commit `4ea9fc3`, pushed

1. `pyproject.toml`: sdist include list gained `rust` and `LICENSE`.
2. `pixi.toml`: dropped both internal channels; lock regenerated against
   conda-forge + bioconda only (232 public URLs, zero internal refs —
   the solve re-resolved a few packages to newer builds).
3. Rewrote the five `/bioproj` references in the 20261022 plans pair and
   the audit to neutral descriptions; kept instrument read names.
4. `pixi run test-fast`: 250 passed, 9 skipped.
5. Pushed everything, including the five commits that were pending.

## B. Release v0.1.0

1. Built the sdist in a throwaway venv (`python -m build --sdist`);
   verified the archive contains `rust/{Cargo.toml,Cargo.lock,src/}`,
   `LICENSE`, `pyproject.toml`.
2. Tagged `v0.1.0`, pushed the tag, created the release with the sdist
   attached.
3. Verified the asset byte-identical to the local build
   (sha256 `00f3057e...adbb`). Note: while the repo was still private,
   the unauthenticated asset URL 404'd; the check used an authenticated
   `gh release download` instead.

## C. Public flip + protections

1. `gh repo edit --visibility public` → `visibility: public`.
2. Branch protection PUT succeeded (blocked earlier while private):
   required check `ci`, linear history, non-locking, verified via GET.
3. Secret scanning + push protection enabled via JSON-body PATCH (the
   first attempt used `-f`, which sent a string and failed with 422).

## D. Conda recipe — conda-recipes `feat: add pairloom recipe`

1. `recipes/pairloom/recipe.yaml`: linux-64 (Rust core — not noarch),
   source = release sdist + sha256, build = pip-install the Python
   package + `maturin build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml` + pip-install
   the core wheel, run deps `python >=3.12,<3.14`, `pysam >=0.24`,
   `pyarrow >=25`, `numpy >=2.5`, tests = imports + `--version`/`--help`.
2. Build iterations: (1) first draft carried a duplicated `requirements:`
   key — caught on re-read before building; (2) pyo3 0.23.5 rejects
   Python > 3.13 and the solver gave the host 3.15 — pinned
   `python >=3.12,<3.14` in host+run; (3) build green
   (`pairloom-0.1.0-h41f06ac_0.conda`).
3. Run-exports verified: `__glibc >=2.17` (the global c_stdlib pin
   worked), `python_abi 3.13 cp313`, no spurious host deps.

## E. Publish to sibio

1. Copied the artifact to `/bioproj/data/minio/sibio_local/linux-64/`,
   ran `pixi run index` then `pixi run upload` from that workspace
   (channel deployed to the local-minio bucket).
2. `pixi search pairloom -c s3://conda/sibio` resolves 0.1.0;
   authoritative repodata `depends` matches the recipe.
3. End-to-end: throwaway pixi project with the sibio channel,
   `pixi add pairloom` solved and installed; `pairloom --version`
   printed 0.1.0 and `--help` rendered. Scratch dirs removed.

# Risks and outcomes

1. Maturin inside rattler-build needed no extra toolchain beyond
   `compiler('rust')` — maturin + cargo cooperated once python was
   pinned.
2. Lock regeneration from public channels solved cleanly.
3. The public flip landed after the scrub push — order held.
4. S3 upload was append-only copy + reindex + mirror per the skill.

# Verification

1. Suite green after the channel removal (250 passed, 9 skipped).
2. Release asset byte-identical to the local sdist.
3. Repo public; protection GET returns the rules; secret scanning
   enabled.
4. Recipe builds clean; glibc floor 2.17.
5. Fresh env installs pairloom from sibio; the CLI runs.
